title: AGGRO DRIFT is a Verhoeven-esque, absurdist parody of the Hollywood action film

commenti.body: I mean, yes, and no. Korine has many films that are at the same time interesting yet difficult to see, because they are gimmicky. I thought beach bum was among his best exactly because he managed to get out of his auto imposed rules and create something meaningful yet enjoyable. This one reminded me more of Hardcore Henry than anything else and was a chore to get through. If that's what cinema is according to him right now, a bunch of videogame languages with a sprinkle of actual filmmaking on top, I feel sorry for him, because he has the talent to make something much more lasting and powerful than a cut scene of 100 minutes, and it seems he dedicated himself more to the promotion of a cringe artist and his videos (Travis Scott) than his own work. I hope he decides to direct that script malick apparently wrote for him.

That script Malick wrote for him could have very easily been The Beach Bum ... would actually make a lot of sense given that movie's tone compared to his other films.

But random speculation aside - it seems like we might share similar sensibilities. Would you recommend this new dumb sounding movie with a rapper I absolutely couldn't care less about?

It isn't. He spoke about the Malick script in the last year or so. 

I don't remember the name of that thing but it was half a videoclip and half a concert film for Travis Scott new album, together with Gaspar noe, refn, and others. If I remember correctly they directed different parts and the director of the finished product was Scott himself. The end result is as disappointing as one can imagine.
